note: The pictures the built player's proof (-gameProof) takes that the HUD budget judges in the batch and that Glyph reviews at 2x (the 2160 set: the same proof at -capture-size 3840x2160). A set names its section of proof.json `frames`, the C# file that takes the pictures and each picture (<name>.png with <name>.hud.png, <name>.manifest.json and <name>.parts.json beside it). tools/game/proofset.test.ts holds every name to the C# source, so a renamed picture is a failing test, not a picture quietly dropped from the budget. `optional`: a picture only some runs take. Add a section's pictures here when its proof lands; `bun tools/game/proofset.ts` says what it does with them.
